notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]We’re thrilled to announce that DREAMO (PC) ⚙️ will launch on February 20th, 2020![/b]

[previewyoutube=GhY0IGlmMiQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Set out on a challenging journey through your mind and unravel the secrets hidden deep in your subconscious. Try to solve every Artifact as you retrieve the memories that slipped away after the plane crash. [b]Do you have what it takes to wake up?[/b]

notes.title: DREAMO Demo Release is Upon Us!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're very excited to finally bring you the demo of DREAMO, which contains a specially prepared Challenge Mode meant to introduce you to the game's plot, setting, and puzzle mechanics.

Five Artifacts await solving! Head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137330/DREAMO/]DREAMO Steam Store[/url] page and download the demo for free.

If you like what you see and want to experience the full story behind your characters' demise, hit that "Add to wishlist" button! DREAMO for PC is coming early next year.
